mechanism_narrative: An increase in the federal funds rate by more than 0.5% in a month signals a tightening monetary policy, which increases borrowing costs and reduces corporate investment, leading to negative S&P 500 forward returns over the next 20 trading days.
failure_condition: If the 20-day forward returns are positive in more than 40% of the instances where FEDFUNDS increased by more than 0.5% in a month.

mechanism_narrative: A sharp increase in the unemployment rate by more than 0.5% in a month indicates a weakening labor market, which can lead to reduced consumer spending and corporate earnings, resulting in negative S&P 500 forward returns over the next 60 trading days.
failure_condition: If the 60-day forward returns are positive in more than 60% of the instances where UNRATE increased by more than 0.5% in a month.

mechanism_narrative: A sustained increase in real GDP growth over two consecutive quarters indicates strong economic demand, which boosts corporate earnings and leads to positive S&P 500 forward returns over the next 60 trading days.
failure_condition: If the 60-day forward returns are negative in more than 40% of the instances where GDPC1 showed sustained growth over two consecutive quarters.

mechanism_narrative: A decrease in industrial production by more than 1% in a month signals a contraction in supply, which can lead to reduced corporate output and earnings, resulting in negative S&P 500 forward returns over the next 20 trading days.
failure_condition: If the 20-day forward returns are positive in more than 50% of the instances where INDPRO decreased by more than 1% in a month.

mechanism_narrative: An increase in housing starts by more than 5% in a month signals a strong demand for housing, which boosts related industries and leads to positive S&P 500 forward returns over the next 5 trading days.
failure_condition: If the 5-day forward returns are negative in more than 60% of the instances where HOUST increased by more than 5% in a month.

mechanism_narrative: When the federal funds rate is above 2% and CPI inflation rises by more than 0.3% in a month, it indicates inflationary pressure during a tightening cycle, leading to negative S&P 500 forward returns over the next 20 trading days.
candidate_trigger: FEDFUNDS > 2% and CPIAUCSL increases > 0.3% in 1 month
failure_condition: If the 20-day forward returns are positive in more than 50% of the instances where FEDFUNDS > 2% and CPIAUCSL increased by more than 0.3% in a month.

mechanism_narrative: When nonfarm payrolls increase by more than 200,000 in a month and the unemployment rate decreases by more than 0.2%, it signals a strong labor market, which boosts consumer spending and corporate earnings, leading to positive S&P 500 forward returns over the next 20 trading days.
candidate_trigger: PAYEMS increases > 200,000 in 1 month and UNRATE decreases > 0.2%
failure_condition: If the 20-day forward returns are negative in more than 40% of the instances where PAYEMS increased by more than 200,000 and UNRATE decreased by more than 0.2% in a month.

mechanism_narrative: A decrease in retail and food services sales by more than 1% in a month indicates weakening consumer demand, which can lead to reduced corporate earnings and negative S&P 500 forward returns over the next 20 trading days.
failure_condition: If the 20-day forward returns are positive in more than 50% of the instances where RSAFS decreased by more than 1% in a month.
